messages.subject: Saudi Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear People Group Arabia Team,

Your Saudi search platform and coverage across construction, infrastructure, engineering, public sector and major projects makes this a relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership portfolio includes government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder engagement, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC where major-project execution depends on institutional relationships, regulatory coordination and responsible development. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
